chapters.title: Exact planning. Read-only by design.
chapters.summary: Choose assets, percentages, and a USDC budget. Lotline reads balances and requests estimates without assembling, signing, or submitting transactions.

chapters.title: A small, explicit trust boundary.
chapters.summary: Next.js route handlers validate inputs and verify issuer metadata, Solana accounts, and Jupiter responses before returning normalized results.

chapters.title: Money enters as strings.
chapters.summary: USDC becomes BigInt micro-units. Percentages become integer basis points totaling 10,000, without binary floating-point money calculations.

chapters.title: Largest remainder keeps the total exact.
chapters.summary: 10.000001 USDC at 50, 30, and 20 percent becomes 5.000001, 3.000000, and 2.000000. Equal remainders use stable basket order.

chapters.title: Verify identity before counting units.
chapters.summary: Resolve the official issuer mint, validate its token program and scaling extension, sum every matching token account, and read the chain clock.

chapters.title: Raw units are not displayed holdings.
chapters.summary: The official Token-2022 helper converts raw holdings plus raw quote output using the mint configuration and active scaled multiplier.

chapters.title: Jupiter receives three quote inputs.
chapters.summary: Only input mint, output mint, and allocated raw amount are sent. No taker or execute call. Quotes expire after at most 30 seconds.

chapters.title: Old responses cannot become a new plan.
chapters.summary: Edits invalidate estimates. Obsolete responses cannot overwrite a current plan. Provider failures and unavailable data remain explicit.

chapters.title: Optional accounts save explicit plans.
chapters.summary: Verified sessions and row-level ownership protect up to 20 saved plans. Wallet addresses, balances, and quotes are excluded. Public email delivery still requires custom SMTP.

chapters.title: Installed web app; fresh data stays online.
chapters.summary: The public offline Example can calculate and export. Live and private APIs stay online. Supabase coordinates bounded provider requests across Vercel instances.

chapters.title: Evidence separates fixtures from live results.
chapters.summary: Tests cover failure and isolation paths. A dated deployed Live smoke observed six verified assets, confirmed zero balances, and a real quote. It is not current pricing.

chapters.title: Take the plan. Keep the choice.
chapters.summary: Copy the plan, export CSV, or review independently on Jupiter. Explore the app at lotlinesolana.vercel.app and source at github.com/operatoruplift/lotline.
